name: decline-adjective
description:
Each word of a phrase, taken as an adjective in the masculine nominative singular, put in the given case.

The word «красный» in the genitive is «красного».

case: "nominative", "genitive", "dative", "accusative", "instrumental" or "prepositional".
gender: "masculine", "feminine" or "neuter", for the singular.
number: "singular" or "plural".

16 forms in all: «красный», «красного», «красному», «красный», «красным», «красном»; «красная», «красной», «красную»; «красное»; «красные», «красных», «красным», «красные», «красными», «красных». The masculine accusative is the inanimate one. A word with a capital keeps it; a word whose ending the tables lack stays.

Example: semkit read --text "красный" --text "новый" decline-adjective genitive write -
-> красного; нового
Example: semkit read --text "красный" decline-adjective dative --number plural write -
-> красным

The step rewrites the working column; with --as NAME it writes the result to a new column NAME.

options.name: --as
options.description: Write the result to a new column NAME and keep the working column as it is.
